bridges.reason: Context and relationships make saved things discoverable.
An unfinished experiment can become the raw material for another.
A clear purpose gives an experiment direction while leaving room to change its plan.
Naming the problem a fragment could solve makes its connection to other work useful.
Small automations remove the administrative cost of collecting.
Deciding what to keep also means deciding what must never be published.
